radiological_findings: Bilateral lung parenchyma well-expanded and clear.
Cardiothoracic ratio normal (< 0.50) with sharp bilateral costophrenic angles.
No focal parenchymal consolidation, apical cavitation, or active pleural reaction.
impression: Normal chest radiograph with high diagnostic confidence. No evidence of active or inactive pulmonary tuberculosis.
recommendation: Routine community health monitoring; no microbiological sputum investigation required at this juncture.

penemuan_radiologi: Parenkima paru-paru kedua-dua belah mengembang dengan baik dan jelas sepenuhnya.
Nisbah kardiotorasik normal (< 0.50) dengan sudut kostofrenik tajam di kedua-dua belah.
Tiada konsolidasi parenkima fokal, kavitasi apikal, atau reaksi pleura aktif.
impresi: X-ray dada normal dengan keyakinan diagnostik tinggi. Tiada tanda tuberkulosis pulmonari aktif atau lampau.
cadangan: Pemantauan kesihatan komuniti rutin; tiada ujian kahak mikrobiologi diperlukan pada masa ini.

radiological_findings: Confluent patchy alveolar consolidation within the apical and posterior segments of the right upper lobe.
Associated ill-defined nodular opacities extending towards the right mid-zone.
Cardiac size within normal limits; left hemithorax clear.
impression: Right upper lobe active parenchymal tuberculosis with early broncho-alveolar spread.
recommendation: Order immediate rapid molecular GeneXpert MTB/RIF test.
Obtain 2 sets of direct sputum AFB smears (spot and early morning).
Register close contact tracing through Pejabat Kesihatan Daerah (PKD).

penemuan_radiologi: Konsolidasi alveolar bertompok di segmen apikal dan posterior lobus atas paru-paru kanan.
Kelegapan nodular tidak bersempadan jelas merebak ke zon tengah kanan.
Saiz jantung dalam had biasa; hemitoraks kiri jelas.
impresi: Tuberkulosis parenkima aktif di lobus atas paru-paru kanan dengan penularan bronko-alveolar awal.
cadangan: Lakukan ujian molekular pantas GeneXpert MTB/RIF dengan segera.
Ambil 2 sampel kahak calitan AFB (spesimen serta-merta dan awal pagi).
Daftar pengesanan kontak rapat melalui Pejabat Kesihatan Daerah (PKD).

radiological_findings: Large, thick-walled cavity measuring approximately 4.6 cm in the right apical-posterior region with an internal air-fluid level.
Extensive surrounding confluent consolidation, volume contraction of the right upper lobe, and ipsilateral tracheal deviation.
Endobronchial acinar tree-in-bud opacities scattered throughout right mid and lower zones.
impression: Advanced cavitary pulmonary tuberculosis with high bacillary burden and extensive endobronchial dissemination.
recommendation: Urgent statutory infectious disease notification under Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 (Act 342).
Stat GeneXpert MTB/RIF and direct microscopy; urgent Chest Physician / TB Clinic referral for initiation of standard 4-drug DOTS regimen (EHRZ).

penemuan_radiologi: Kavitasi besar berdinding tebal berukuran kira-kira 4.6 cm di kawasan apikal-posterior kanan dengan paras cecair-udara.
Konsolidasi meluas di sekeliling, pengecutan isipadu lobus atas kanan dan deviasi trakea ke sisi ipsilateral.
Kelegapan asinar endobronkial 'tree-in-bud' bertaburan di zon tengah dan bawah kanan.
impresi: Tuberkulosis pulmonari kavitasi peringkat lanjutan dengan beban bakteria tinggi dan penularan endobronkial meluas.
cadangan: PENGASINGAN PERNAFASAN UDARA SERTA-MERTA (langkah pencegahan N95).
Notifikasi statutori segera di bawah Akta Pencegahan dan Pengawalan Penyakit Berjangkit 1988 (Akta 342).
Ujian segera GeneXpert MTB/RIF dan mikroskopi calitan; rujukan kecemasan ke Klinik Pakar Respiratori untuk rejimen 4-ubat DOTS (EHRZ).
